latest_release.name: v3.8.53
latest_release.body:
# OmniRoute v3.8.53

**1,189 documented changes** from 1,162 commits in the cycle, with **222 people** contributing. Thank you all.

📄 **Complete release notes** (every entry, full description and credit): attached below as `CHANGELOG-v3.8.53.md`, and in [`CHANGELOG.md` → `[3.8.53]`](https://github.com/cheaper-inference/OmniRoute/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

⚠️ Known at release time: `providers.apiRegionLabel` (fi, ko, pl, pt, pt-BR, zh-CN, zh-TW) and `providers.apiRegionInternational` (fi) show their English text until they are retranslated in v3.8.54.

### 📊 Release by the numbers

| | |
| --- | ---: |
| 👥 People who contributed | **222** |
| 📝 Commits in the cycle | **1,162** |
| 🔀 Pull requests referenced | **847** |
| 📋 Changelog entries | **1,189** |
| 🙌 Contributors credited in entries | **221** |
| 🤖 Automated dependency commits | 11 |

**Entries by type**

| Type | Count |
| --- | ---: |
| 🐛 Fixes | 588 |
| ♻️ Refactor | 204 |
| ✨ Features | 146 |

| 🏗️ Build | 2 |

### ✨ New Features

- **feat(dashboard):** the dashboard and the standalone pages (login, status, error, legal, docs) run on the Keak CI UI Kit (KEA-7886), vendored as the `packages/ui-kit` workspace at a pinned upstream commit (`packages/ui-kit/UPSTREAM.md`, byte-identity guarded by `npm run check:ui-kit-snapshot`). The Keak identity replaces the old one — lime accent, self-hosted Inter / Instrument Serif / IBM Plex Mono, kit radius…
- **feat(teams):** add billing cost centers with temporal API-key assignments, shared soft budgets, and team usage reporting (#10409) — thanks @hartmark / @xiaoyaner0201
- **feat(gemini):** add an opt-in `geminiPromptCacheMode` setting (`off` by default, `implicit`) scoped to Antigravity/AGY Gemini targets that preserves Gemini implicit prompt-cache evidence (`hit` / `miss` / `unreported` / `invalid`) across streaming, non-streaming, wrapped/unwrapped, OpenAI and Claude paths, never reports a cached count larger than the prompt, keeps prompt-cache affinity from reusing…
- **feat(release):** `npm run bun:release` (`scripts/release/bun-pack.mjs`) packs the already-built `dist/` into an npm-compatible tarball with `bun pm pack` (falling back to `npm pack`) for bun-first global installs; the Next.js build and prepublish step stay on Node. Thanks to @opensource-elearning (#12801).
- **feat(oauth):** GitHub Copilot connections record the account's plan, model-selection mode and quota state, and the dashboard shows a policy disclosure before the device-code login; Free / Student accounts use the catalog's `auto` model (#12833) — thanks @ScottyAmr
